# Escalation Template

## Server-Level Issue Escalation

Hi Team,

The customer is experiencing persistent WooCommerce checkout failures despite standard troubleshooting.

### Troubleshooting Performed
- Disabled all plugins except WooCommerce
- Switched to default theme
- Cleared cache and CDN
- Tested in incognito mode
- Verified payment gateway settings

### Findings
- PHP errors continue appearing in server logs
- Issue may be related to server configuration or hosting environment

### Requested Action
Please investigate:
- PHP configuration
- ModSecurity/firewall rules
- Server error logs
- Database performance

Thank you.
